result.brief: 提出物理一致的视觉-触觉仿真器、跨多种机械手的基准与触觉策略，并用共享码本的双流VQ-VAE对齐力阵列与触觉图像表征。
result.reason: Visuo-tactile simulator, benchmark and policy for robotic manipulation; includes two-stream VQ-VAE representation alignment, but main contribution is simulation/policy rather than video or visual representation.
